law_name: Personal Data Protection Ordinance, 2025 (Ordinance No. 61 of 2025)
scope: Data subjects (individuals) whose personal data is processed
applies_to: Government and private entities acting as data custodians or processors of personal data
key_requirements: Explicit consent before collection, storage, transfer or use of personal data; data-subject ownership/rights; administrative fines, compensation and criminal penalties for violations
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data (financial, health, genetic, biometric) with enhanced protection; children's/minors' data with special safeguards
penalties_range: Administrative penalties, compensation, fines and other punishments for data-security violations; amounts not stated in source
research_exemption: Exemptions for statistical research (also crime prevention, journalism etc.) subject to proportionate safeguards for data subjects (Chs. V-VI); section numbers unverified
genetic_data: Genetic information listed as sensitive personal data with enhanced protection
notes: Issued as an ordinance by the interim government; some sections reportedly take effect 18 months after gazette notification (Daily Star); parliamentary ratification unconfirmed; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
